description: Decide which Odile product fits a job: Gate (limit what an agent may call on your own HTTPS API, with approvals and an audit log) or Direct (reach a business by its phone number). Returns use_when, not_for, first steps, free allowances and limits for each. Use it before connecting either one; for prices use get_m2m_network. Needs no sign-in or arguments, reads no account and contacts no business.
name: get_agent_services
title: When to use OdileM2M, Gate or Direct
